rules.rationale: Android 16 retains the host retry action, optional download-id filter, failed-connection reset, query and job rescheduling, plus the one-second override deadline. It moves the exported action out of the multi-purpose DownloadReceiver into RetryDownloadReceiver and validates the sender UID/advanced permission before accessing all-downloads state.
rules.necessity: Required for the host to wake downloads that are waiting for retry/network without waiting for platform backoff.
rules.performance: Work runs on the provider async handler, performs one bounded update/query over pending states and schedules only matching rows. It is action-triggered, not a polling path.
rules.security: Improves A13 by rejecting arbitrary exported-broadcast callers; only root, shell, system, the provider itself or holders of ACCESS_DOWNLOAD_MANAGER_ADVANCED may request retries.
validation_evidence: A13 commit 6be0a14 and target commit db61a3d were reviewed hunk by hunk. Component branch aosp16-bst-merge is clean; authorized and unauthorized broadcast tests remain pending.
